anchors.description: Wooden buffet/sideboard with dark stone top and cabriole legs against the wall; vertical distance from the tabletop surface near its front-right corner down to the floor contact at the foot of the front-right leg.
anchors.visible_evidence: The cabinet has two drawers and two doors below a dark slab top, a typical buffet/sideboard. In the image its height from floor to top is about 108 px against a width of about 180 px (ratio ~0.6), matching a ~1.4-1.5 m wide buffet of ~0.85 m height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Generic furniture category; no model or exact spec visible. Buffet/sideboard heights range roughly 0.76-0.95 m, so the point-to-point length (top surface to floor at leg foot) is only category-level known.
